name: GreenWash-Screener 4-Pillar Greenwashing Taxonomy
description: Evaluation criteria used by the hybrid LLM + rule-based engine. Every pillar is scored as a RISK from 0 (fully substantiated) to 100 (pure greenwashing). The claim risk is the weighted sum of the four pillar risks.

quantification.name: Quantification Test
quantification.subtitle: Vagueness vs. Hard Metrics
quantification.question: Is the claim backed by specific figures with physical units, or does it rely on vague buzzwords?
quantification.high_risk_definition: Uses vague buzzwords (eco-friendly, green, sustainable leader, climate conscious) without numerical metrics or units.
quantification.legit_definition: Contains specific figures and units (tCO2e, MWh, %, GJ, m3, megalitres) with a reference period.

rubric.0-20: Absolute and relative figures with units, reporting period and comparison to prior year.
rubric.21-50: Some figures but missing units, period or absolute values (intensity-only).
rubric.51-80: Mostly qualitative with a single unanchored number.

trajectory.name: Trajectory & Roadmap Test
trajectory.subtitle: Timeline & Baseline
trajectory.question: Does a forward-looking claim have a base year, interim milestones, an action/CAPEX plan or third-party (SBTi) validation?
trajectory.high_risk_definition: Long-term target (e.g., Net-Zero by 2050) with no baseline year, no interim target (e.g., 2030) and no CAPEX or action plan.
trajectory.legit_definition: Clear baseline year, short-to-medium term milestones, CAPEX plan, or SBTi validation.

rubric.0-20: SBTi-validated near-term and long-term targets, base year, annual progress tracking.
rubric.21-50: Base year and interim target but no validation or resourcing evidence.
rubric.51-80: Target year only, or interim target without base year.
rubric.81-100: Distant aspiration (2040-2060) with no base year, no milestones and no plan.

scope.name: Scope & Materiality Test
scope.subtitle: Cherry-Picking vs. Full Scope
scope.question: Does the claim cover material emissions (Scope 1, 2 and material Scope 3 categories) as required by SASB/ISSB, or does it highlight marginal initiatives?
scope.high_risk_definition: Highlights marginal initiatives (solar panels on HQ cafeteria, plastic-free office) while omitting material Scope 1, 2 and especially Scope 3 supply-chain emissions.
scope.legit_definition: Explicitly covers Scope 1, Scope 2 and material Scope 3 categories with organizational boundary.

rubric.0-20: Scope 1, 2 and material Scope 3 categories (e.g., Cat. 1, Cat. 11) quantified; boundary stated.
rubric.21-50: Scope 1 and 2 covered; Scope 3 partial or only qualitative.
rubric.51-80: Single scope or single site; material sources (PFCs, supply chain) omitted.
rubric.81-100: Marginal, non-material initiative presented as climate leadership.

assurance.name: External Assurance & Standard Alignment Test
assurance.subtitle: Verification
assurance.question: Is the claim mapped to a specific standard indicator and backed by independent third-party assurance?
assurance.high_risk_definition: Self-declared achievement with zero reference to GRI/SASB/TCFD/ISSB codes or third-party assurance.
assurance.legit_definition: Mapped to specific standard indicators (e.g., GRI 305-1, TCFD Metrics) and backed by limited or reasonable assurance from a recognised provider.

rubric.0-20: Reasonable assurance (or limited assurance by Big Four / accredited body) explicitly covering the metric, plus standard code mapping.
rubric.21-50: Standard mapping present, or general assurance statement not clearly covering the metric.
rubric.51-80: Generic reference to 'international standards' without codes or assurer.

examples.claim: We aspire to become carbon neutral by 2050 through eco-friendly innovation.
examples.why: Vague buzzwords, distant aspiration, no baseline, no scope, no assurance.

examples.claim: Scope 1 and 2 emissions fell 18% to 9.8 million tCO2e versus our 2020 base year (market-based), verified with limited assurance by DNV under ISO 14064-3; our SBTi-validated 2030 target is -42%.
examples.why: Quantified, base year, interim SBTi target, explicit scopes, third-party assurance.

examples.claim: Our headquarters cafeteria is now powered by rooftop solar panels and is 100% plastic-free.
examples.why: Marginal, non-material initiative presented as climate leadership (cherry-picking).
